analyses.content: 录音里说案例和例子不仅来自农村地区，也来自“cities”（城市），刚好对应题目里的“as well as rural areas”。
你可能听到“modernist practice”就想填practice，但要注意听后面的并列短语“both in... and...”，和题目结构完全一致，不要填错位置。

Throughout this lecture series, we will be looking at the latest research into climatic design carried out by experts in the field, in addition to case studies and examples drawn from modernist practice, both in cities and rural areas.
录音提到最近从“bank”（银行）那里收到了一笔巨额捐款，对应题目问的从哪里收到了资金。
你可能会把一开始听到的“Private organizations”当成答案，但题目问的是“从哪收到钱（received from）”，往后听才能抓到真正掏钱的“bank”。
Private organizations have also been raising awareness and funds and recently received a huge donation from the bank.
录音提到在高海拔地区酸性污染物较少，这就意味着“skyscrapers”（摩天大楼）接触到的破坏性污染物水平要低得多。
你可能听到“higher altitudes”想填altitudes，但这里是在解释为什么“摩天大楼”受到的污染少，题目缺的是受影响的主体。

Research has shown that there are lower levels of acid in the damaging pollutants at higher altitudes, meaning that skyscrapers are much less vulnerable to the negative effects as they are exposed to acid rain with far lower levels of damaging pollutants.
录音里介绍Altar项目是为了研究酸雨对传统的“stone construction”（石制建筑/石头）的影响，对应题目里问的建筑是由什么材料制成的（made of）。
你可能听到“old traditional buildings”就想把traditional buildings填上去，但题目问的是建筑的材质，要填它后面的修饰词“stone”。

Recently, the Altar Project was founded to carry out further research into acid rain. This project is directed towards studying the effects of acid rain on old traditional buildings of stone construction that are vulnerable to damage caused by acid rain.
录音明确提到天空塔（Sky Tower）的窗户是用“recycled glass”（回收玻璃）制成的，用来防止污染。
你可能只抓到了“glass”就往上写，漏掉了前面的“recycled”，普通玻璃不能减少污染，只有加上“回收”意思才完整。
A recent case study for this is Sky Tower, whose windows have been made from recycled glass to prevent pollution from the glass making process.
录音里指出冬天不适合施工，因为大量的“rainfall”（降雨）会对建筑产生不利影响，题目的increased对应录音里的heavy。
你可能听到“winter”后以为答案还在后面而分心，但这句直接给出了原因，顺着听就能抓到具体是降雨带来的麻烦。
This makes winter an undesirable season for construction as the heavy rainfall can have adverse effects on the building.
录音用转折词However引出，湿度会对“wooden”（木制的）建筑产生严重影响，并在下一句补充了水分会在木头纹理里凝结。
你可能听到前面说的“steel and stone”就急着填，但那句话说的是它们不受影响（unaffected），听到However转折后才是真正的答案。

However, it can have a serious effect on wooden constructions if the timber has not been correctly treated. Moisture from the air can condense in the grain of the wood, which then swells and shrinks in proportion to the magnitude of change in its moisture content.
录音提到地面条件是个让人头疼的问题，因为通常“soil”（土壤）的密度不对，直接对应题目里的“the density of the ___ is wrong”。
你可能会因为刚听到“ground conditions”就放松了警惕，但要注意听后面解释具体是什么东西密度不对，别填成 foundations。
Ground conditions are a cause for worry in many constructions, as often the soil is of the wrong density to protect the foundations.
录音里说建筑师现在可以去测量和监测建筑结构的“movement”（移动），换成题目里主动的说法就是建筑师可以监测movement。
你可能听到“building structures”就想填structures，但题目问的是监测建筑的什么特征，要往前找这个主语movement。
The movement of building structures can now also be measured and monitored over time by architects.
录音里说预计政府在不久的将来会出台“guidelines”（指南），用来给建筑师提供检查清单，正好对应题目里政府应该为建筑师制定什么。
你可能听到最后的“a universal checklist”想填checklist，但题目问的是政府要制作/出台（make）什么，对应的动作承受者是开头的guidelines。
Guidelines are also expected to be produced by the government in the near future that will give architects a universal checklist to follow.
